answer: Trust propagation from a seed set: a few audited agents start with trust, and it flows only along edges where an agent posted a bond to vouch for another. Each hop dilutes trust like pigment in water, so a swarm of fake identities joined to the honest graph by one thin edge gets only a faint trust signal, however many members it spawns. To gain real weight the attacker must bribe many bonded vouchers, a cost that rises with every hop toward the horizon of the trusted core.
